title: Poor quality!
text: Poor quality!. Shiny Brite is known for the beauty of the ornaments. However, I ordered these and they were horrible. The design was out of place and it was missing paint in places...I was so disappointed with the Shiny Brite glass ornaments! 🙃

product_metadata.title: Shiny Brite Festive FETE 6 Count 3.25" Decorated Reflector Rounds
features: The Shiny Brite company produced the most popular ornaments in American throughout the 1940s and 50s.
These glass ornament reproductions make available the lovely colors and patterns from those memorable days.
In 2001 Christopher Radko, world renowned producer of fine hand painted ornaments, began reproducing Shiny Brite ornaments. They are even packaged in a vintage styled box.
For many of us, they immediately evoke treasured memories of Christmases spent with family and friends.
description: The Christopher Radko company, world renowned for producing some of the world's finest hand painted Christmas Ornaments began reproducing Shiny Brite ornaments in 2001.
